jobs.title: Seasonal Sales Associate (Part-Time) - Market Street at Lynnfield
jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Seasonal Sales Associate supports store goals during peak and high-volume business periods by delivering exceptional guest experiences and bringing the ALO Brand Mission to life. jobs.title: Senior Asset Protection Analyst
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW In all we do, we strive to uphold Alo’s Guiding Principles with a “Together We Win” attitude and a relentless pursuit of excellence. The Senior Asset Protection Analyst is based at Alo’s Beverly Hills headquarters and provides analytical leadership, risk intelligence, and executive reporting for the Asset Protection & Safety function. The position is primarily focused on identifying and mitigating risk across Alo’s retail sanctuaries. The Senior Analyst will also evaluate relevant enterprise data and support risk analysis across broader company operations as business needs evolve. Operating with an AI-first mindset, the Senior Analyst uses approved artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and established Asset Protection methodologies to detect risk earlier, improve investigative efficiency, and guide strategic decisions. The role transforms complex data into actionable insights that protect company assets, safeguard employees and guests, and strengthen operational integrity. Consistent with Alo’s “Together We Win” principle, the Senior Analyst works collaboratively across functions, shares insights, builds alignment, and helps stakeholders turn data into meaningful action. jobs.title: Senior Employment Counsel
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW ALO is seeking a mid-to-senior employment attorney to manage employment counseling, contract, and policy needs as we expand in North America. This position is a great opportunity for an experienced attorney looking to take ownership of a broad array of employment issues in a fast-paced, growing company. As Senior Employment Counsel, you will serve as a key legal advisor on all aspects of employment law, policy, immigration and compliance across our U.S. and Canada operations. You will work closely with ALO’s Director of Employment, HR, Retail, and Payroll teams to ensure that our company remains compliant with local, state, federal, and international labor laws, while also addressing a wide range of legal matters related to our workforce. You will also mentor and support other members of the legal team on employment matters. The ideal candidate has six to ten years of experience with employment advice and counseling at a top employment law firm and in-house. The position is an in-office role based in Beverly Hills, CA. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide day-to-day legal advice on employment law matters, including accommodations, classification, compensation, discipline, hiring, immigration/right-to-work, leaves of absence, separations and workplace investigations. jobs.title: IT & Workplace Operations Lead
jobs.description_text: About the Role This is a hands-on role with a broad mandate. You’ll own the day-to-day technology experience for Formicans: computers, accounts, applications, permissions, onboarding and offboarding, endpoint management, IT support, office technology, and our relationship with our outside IT partner. You'll also help own the day-to-day experience of our Bolingbrook office and warehouse, making sure the space is organized, stocked, functional, and a great place to work. If the Wi-Fi is down, someone's badge doesn't work, a conference room isn't connecting, the TV needs to be ready for All Hands, a new hire needs a laptop, or the office is running low on something, you're the person who makes sure it gets handled. You aren't expected to personally pull every cable, install every camera, or perform every repair. You are expected to own the outcome. You don't need to know every system we use on Day 1. We'd rather hire someone with strong technical fundamentals, exceptional resourcefulness, and an ability to learn quickly. Over time, we expect you to become an expert in Formic's technology environment. You do need to be highly capable at using AI to extend what you can do. We want someone who is genuinely excited about technology and constantly asks: Why are we doing this manually? Can I automate it? Can I make this better? jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the team: The Project Engineering team is a multidisciplinary engineering group within Automation Engineering Group, bringing mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering together under a single organization. The team serves as the engineering escalation path for the deployed fleet, taking on problems that exceed field-level troubleshooting and converting them into scoped, engineered, and standardized solutions. The team's work spans three connected areas. The first is the troubleshooting of complex problems: diagnosing multi-discipline failures across deployed robotic systems and engineering permanent, root-cause fixes rather than repeat repairs. The second is continuous improvement: converting recurring issues and field data into reliability upgrades and fleet-wide standardization. The third is support for existing and new product development and enhancements, in partnership with teams across the organization, to improve equipment currently in the field and to bring new capability online. Positioned at the intersection of design, commissioning, and field support, the team operates as a cross-functional unit, with engineers at the Bolingbrook hub working alongside field implementation resources across North America. The work is a deliberate blend of reactive support and proactive engineering, and each role on the team contributes to uptime, performance consistency, and long-term customer outcomes across the fleet.
